speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with a rash on your scalp and forehead; to help narrow down the cause, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any new products or medications recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Seborrheic Dermatitis (Infantile Cradle Cap). The clinical picture of a scalp and forehead rash in a 3-month-old, which is exacerbated by cold weather and has a familial association with psoriasis, is highly characteristic of this condition. No further tests are required at this time.
